rule: If it is not recorded here, it has not entered the Maison project.

entries.name: Maison Commercial Asset Context
entries.role: rebuildable commercial catalogue projection plus optional private operational overlay for existing-asset-first reasoning
entries.cost: existing repository data; no API cost
entries.notes: Generated registry currently derives 5 active physical products, 2 future products, 9 non-B2B services and 1 B2B service. Catalogue availability is not counted inventory. Quantity, costs, packaging, production time, MOQ, shelf life and capacity remain UNKNOWN unless supplied in an evidence-backed private overlay kept outside git.

entries.name: Maison Semantic Projection Sync
entries.role: manual incremental projection from canonical Brain Control API/D1 observations into rebuildable pgvector Semantic Memory
entries.cost: 0 API cost for local embedding/runtime; local CPU/RAM required
entries.license: Maison repo + pgvector + pinned multilingual E5 dependency
entries.notes: Manual only, no scheduler. Requires explicit provider-prefix privacy allowlist and refuses empty allowlist. Cursor lives in disposable projection DB; canonical evidence remains D1. Current env example begins with eurostat_ only.

entries.name: Maison Canonical Brain Observe Cycle
entries.role: one-shot read-only analysis flow from canonical A13/A5/A4/A3/A11 data through Pre-Brain, Scout, Critic, Foundry and A14 preview
entries.notes: Optional/manual only. Uses A5 mappings, Oceanos, commercial catalogue asset context, A3 realised economics, A11 correlation-only learning and optional Semantic/Osiris retrieval. These supporting contexts add no independent evidence roots. A14 output remains preview-only; writes_performed=false and execution_authority=false.

entries.name: Maison Brain Control API
entries.role: authenticated GET-only bridge from canonical D1/A13/A4/A3 data to the private persistent Brain runtime
entries.notes: Disabled by default. Exposes canonical A13/A5 feed, all A3 economic feedback, safe solution fields, A4 need↔solution links and safe A11 learning context. No write routes; no customer/journey identity. Separate private_brain_read_candidate stage can later enable reads while sensing remains off; authenticated HTTPS/Cloudflare Access recommended in addition to bearer auth.

entries.name: Maison Brain MCP read-only surface
entries.role: stable read-only tool port for agents to query Brain status, Oceanos metadata, Osiris graph context and Semantic Memory without direct database access
entries.notes: Optional localhost-only profile. Exactly four read-only tools; no outreach, publication, catalogue, price, checkout, spend or database-write tools.

entries.name: Maison Persistent Observe Runtime
entries.role: private persistent host stack for Osiris Memory, PostgreSQL/pgvector, Redis and authenticated A13 memory bridge
entries.license: mixed: Maison repo + upstream Osiris AGPL-3.0-or-later + pgvector PostgreSQL License + Redis upstream terms
entries.notes: Repository stage remains infra_only. Compose includes pinned pgvector/Postgres, Redis, Osiris, authenticated A13 bridge, Brain observe cycle, Brain MCP, manual semantic sync and health/smoke profiles; all published ports bind 127.0.0.1. Semantic/Osiris read context switches are off by default. No external provider activation, spend, outbound or public write authority.

entries.name: A14 Universal Opportunity + Earned Distribution
entries.role: evidence-backed bridge from need/opportunity to offer type, distribution fit, activation recommendation and commercial learning
entries.notes: Analysis-only. Existing-asset-first; UNKNOWN remains unknown; contextual amplifier×offer×moment fit. Opportunity/offer/distribution hypothesis IDs are deterministic from canonical semantic payloads and repository persistence is strict/idempotent; same-ID payload drift is rejected. No autonomous outreach, spend, catalogue/price/checkout mutation or public write.

entries.name: A13 External Intelligence Mesh
entries.notes: External outputs remain untrusted observations; no public-write authority.

entries.name: A12 Gradual Autonomy
entries.role: risk, autonomy, human approval, kill switches and audit
entries.notes: Central policy; do not duplicate governance inside every framework.

entries.name: Commercial learning chain A3+A7+A8+A11
entries.role: economics, commercial candidates, experiments and learning
entries.notes: Needs explicit bridge from insight/opportunity to experiment to realised revenue.

entries.name: OSIRIS OSINT
entries.notes: Passive allowlist only. Active scanning/recon excluded. Per-source cadence must be tuned before activation.

entries.name: Osiris Memory
entries.cost: software target open/self-hosted; host resources required
entries.notes: Upstream requirements and AGPL-3.0-or-later verified; pinned observe-runtime build at upstream commit 181658e1db85ce4d2e8702124423b674b3cb136f. A13 writes through an authenticated bridge using Osiris Actions Waist; Brain reads through private MCP graph_search. No direct graph SQL. Runtime prepared but not started.

entries.name: OpenRouter
entries.cost: free models plus paid models depending route
entries.notes: Already has branch adapter; ungrounded by default unless citations are independently sourced.

entries.name: Osiris AI Gateway
entries.notes: Do not chain as mandatory proxy between LiteLLM and OpenRouter; use as parallel route if retained.

entries.name: LiteLLM
entries.role: stable Maison model aliases, budgets, routing and fallbacks across direct/gateway/local models
entries.notes: Value rises when Maison combines direct providers, OpenRouter, optional Osiris route and local models.

entries.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
entries.role: stable allowlisted tool contract between Brain/agents and Maison systems
entries.notes: Pinned Python SDK 1.28.1 is now used by Maison Brain for private Osiris graph_search read context. Initial Maison MCP use remains read-only; write tools stay A12-gated.

entries.name: DuckDB
entries.notes: Optional analytical backend implemented in brain/prebrain.py. Used for aggregation before expensive reasoning; never canonical storage.

entries.name: Polars
entries.notes: Optional analytical backend implemented in brain/prebrain.py. Used for fast local transforms; never canonical storage.

entries.name: GLiNER
entries.license: reported Apache-2.0; verify exact selected model
entries.notes: Optional adapter implemented in brain/prebrain_adapters.py; exact model/checkpoint remains operator-configured and licence-verified before runtime use. Entity output is hypothesis/structure, not truth.

entries.name: Ruptures
entries.notes: Optional change-point adapter implemented in brain/prebrain_adapters.py; algorithm/model/penalty are explicit runtime policy. Signal generator only.

entries.name: BERTopic / HDBSCAN-class clustering
entries.role: discover emerging clusters/topics before labels exist
entries.notes: Evaluate multilingual PT/ES/EN performance and operational cost.

entries.name: DoWhy
entries.notes: Cannot manufacture causality from weak data; use mainly after enough measurements exist.

entries.name: Crawl4AI
entries.role: local public-web reading/extraction into clean text
entries.notes: Respect robots, terms, rate limits and copyright; public readability != reuse rights.

entries.name: RSSHub
entries.role: normalize many changing public sources into feeds
entries.notes: Route/source terms still apply.

entries.name: changedetection.io
entries.role: watch public pages for price/copy/catalogue/stock changes
entries.notes: Use public pages and conservative polling.

entries.name: Faster-Whisper
entries.role: local transcription of lawful public audio/video sources
entries.notes: Transcription rights and source terms must be respected; do not archive copyrighted bodies unnecessarily.

entries.name: YAMNet-class audio event classification
entries.notes: Low current commercial priority.

entries.name: Florence-2 / Moondream-class local VLM
entries.notes: Evaluate model-specific commercial licence before choosing.

entries.name: Aggregate people/queue/occupancy CV detector
entries.role: anonymous counts/flow/occupancy from permitted public imagery
entries.notes: No facial recognition, person identity, re-identification or cross-camera tracking.

entries.name: Ultralytics YOLO
entries.notes: Rejected for now because Maison needs a permissive commercial-safe CV path without unwanted copyleft/enterprise licence dependency.

entries.name: OpenAlex
entries.cost: usage-based API with free daily account budget; Maison cap required
entries.license: OpenAlex data CC0; API service has usage-based access terms
entries.notes: A13 metadata-only search adapter implemented. Production path requires account API key; key never enters URL/provenance. API-reported cost is recorded. No PDF/full-text downloads.

entries.name: PubChem
entries.notes: Scientific reference; never automatic safety/medical claim authority.

entries.name: EU CosIng
entries.notes: Use official EU source as reference; legal/compliance review remains separate.

entries.name: Open Beauty Facts
entries.notes: Crowdsourced data quality must be scored; never infer product safety solely from it.

entries.name: Project Gutenberg
entries.license: work-specific public-domain status; territorial check required
entries.notes: US public-domain status is not automatically enough for Portugal/EU reuse.

entries.name: Standard Ebooks
entries.notes: Verify text, typography/assets and territorial rights separately.

entries.name: Internet Archive
entries.role: historical books/media discovery and archival research
entries.notes: Only ingest/reuse items whose rights permit intended Maison use.

entries.name: Europeana
entries.notes: High value for visual/historical products if rights metadata is preserved.

entries.name: Wikisource
entries.notes: Preserve source/provenance.

entries.name: Typst + Pandoc
entries.role: compile Maison manuscripts into PDF/EPUB and other artefacts
entries.notes: Formatting engine only; editorial QA and rights checks remain mandatory.

entries.name: Eurostat
entries.cost: official API access free of charge
entries.notes: A13 adapter implemented with explicit query profiles/cadences and master+source kill switches. Official Statistics API returns JSON-stat 2.0; no default datasets are silently queried.

entries.name: INE Portugal
entries.notes: Official source preferred for Portugal-specific indicators.

entries.name: BASE.gov.pt
entries.cost: public data; high-volume API requires prior IMPIC authorization/token
entries.license: verify API/data reuse and rate conditions
entries.notes: A13 official API adapter implemented for allowlisted contract/announcement/modification/entity endpoints. No token = no task. Weekly open-data route remains a separate future option.

entries.name: FRED
entries.notes: Lower priority than Eurostat/INE for Maison core markets.

entries.name: H3
entries.notes: Aggregate geography only; avoid sensitive individual movement profiles.

entries.name: DuckDB Spatial
entries.notes: Pairs naturally with H3 for low-cost local analysis.

entries.name: Maison Semantic Memory contract
entries.role: stable adapter boundary for semantic retrieval independent of database
entries.notes: Stable A5 semantic contract plus brain/semantic_memory.py projection interface. First backend is pgvector; manual allowlisted D1→pgvector sync implemented. Backend remains rebuildable/swappable and semantic similarity never becomes independent evidence.

entries.name: Qdrant
entries.notes: Valid self-hosted alternative, but not first runtime path because Osiris already requires PostgreSQL+vector. Re-evaluate only if Qdrant demonstrates unique retrieval/operations value.

entries.name: PostgreSQL + pgvector
entries.role: first Maison Semantic Memory backend experiment, sharing PostgreSQL infrastructure already required by Osiris Memory
entries.notes: Backend implemented in brain/semantic_pgvector.py. pgvector 0.8.6 / PostgreSQL 16 image pinned in observe runtime. Embedding model/dimensions remain explicit and unselected; runtime not yet provisioned.

entries.name: Apache AGE / maintained embedded graph candidate
entries.role: entity/relation graph analytics beyond semantic similarity
entries.notes: Graph analytics remain an experiment. KùzuDB was archived by its maintainers on 2025-10-10 and must not be adopted as a new production dependency; evaluate actively maintained alternatives only, and avoid duplicating Osiris Memory graph functions without a clear capability gap.

entries.name: Cloudflare Workflows / Durable Objects
entries.role: durable long-running workflow state close to current Cloudflare stack
entries.notes: Evaluate before adding a separate orchestration platform.

entries.name: LangGraph
entries.notes: Use only if it adds cognitive workflow capabilities not already covered by Cloudflare durable execution.

entries.name: Hatchet
entries.notes: Compare with Cloudflare Workflows before introducing another operational plane.

entries.name: n8n
entries.cost: self-host software/host cost; licence has use restrictions
entries.license: Sustainable Use/fair-code family; verify intended use
entries.notes: Not the Brain. Avoid implementing the same workflow in n8n and cognitive orchestrator.

entries.name: Local model runtime (Ollama-class)
entries.role: cheap/private local inference for suitable small models
entries.license: runtime and each model must be verified separately
entries.notes: Do not choose model size until hardware is known.

entries.name: intfloat/multilingual-e5-small
entries.role: first local multilingual embedding model for Maison Semantic Memory
entries.sense: semantic retrieval PT/PT-BR/ES/EN and broader multilingual text
entries.notes: Pinned to Hugging Face revision 03415a4be176a1620747c692ed433219fabc3def; 384 dimensions. Provider implements required E5 query:/passage: prefixes and normalized embeddings. Runtime/model weights not yet provisioned.

entries.name: Local embeddings / FastEmbed-class runtime
entries.role: low-cost local embeddings for semantic index
entries.notes: Embedding model must be stable and multilingual; changing dimensions/model implies reindex.

entries.name: Maison Pre-Brain
entries.role: local filter before LLM: dedupe, anomaly detection, lightweight classification, clustering, weak-signal convergence
entries.notes: Implemented analysis-only core in .github/maison-growth/brain/prebrain.py with A13 feed view; DuckDB/Polars adapters are optional analytical backends, not canonical stores.

entries.name: Maison Scout
entries.role: continuous discovery of unmet needs, anomalies and unasked commercial opportunities
entries.notes: Implemented in brain/scout.py; produces internal evidence-linked opportunity candidates only and enforces existing-asset-first context.

entries.name: Maison Critic
entries.role: adversarially challenge Scout proposals before human inbox
entries.notes: Implemented in brain/critic.py; challenges source independence, contradictions, economics and operational unknowns before A14 forwarding.

entries.name: Maison Content & Product Foundry
entries.role: turn validated territories into original digital/physical/service product families
entries.notes: Implemented in brain/foundry.py across physical, digital, service, experience, B2B, wholesale, white-label, licensing and other A14 offer types; no launch authority.

entries.name: Opportunity / Revenue Per Insight attribution
entries.role: link Brain insight -> commercial candidate -> experiment -> conversion -> revenue -> learning
entries.notes: Extend existing attribution rather than build a parallel economics system.

entries.name: Original pytrends dependency
entries.notes: Do not make an archived/unofficial client a critical dependency. Seek current lawful alternatives or direct sources.

entries.name: Pinecone
entries.notes: Rejected for now: Qdrant/pgvector experiments cover the capability without adding a proprietary dependency.

entries.name: Chroma
entries.notes: Rejected for now to avoid testing three vector stores simultaneously; reconsider only if Qdrant/pgvector fail a concrete requirement.

entries.name: KùzuDB
entries.notes: Rejected for new Maison production use: official repository was archived by maintainers on 2025-10-10 and is read-only. Preserve only as historical candidate; choose a maintained graph engine if a graph gap remains after Osiris Memory.
